name: rainforest-navigator
description: Query and manage navigation entries stored in the RainForest Navigator browser extension and generate matching SVG website icons.

interface.longDescription: Search, add, edit, delete, and apply generated SVG icons to entries stored in the RainForest Navigator Chrome extension through an OAuth-secured remote MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Search my RainForest browser-extension navigation entries.
Add a site and generate a matching RainForest icon.
Update an entry stored in my browser extension.
